acceptance: A title or body edit with no base change does not start or cancel CI (filter `edited` to base changes, or skip code jobs for it)
Jobs of a run cancelled by a newer same-PR run do not appear as failed checks on the PR
Workflow test covering the edited-event behaviour
description: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs on `pull_request` types including `edited` (line 9) with `concurrency: cancel-in-progress: true` (lines 12-14). Any title or body edit therefore starts a full CI run and cancels the one in progress. The cancelled run's jobs then appear in `gh pr checks` as failures. On #3092 (2026-10-17), after a body edit, cancelled run 39051130924 left `medium-test (shard ${{ matrix.shard_index }})` (job 117450436540) listed as `fail` after the PR merged, alongside cancelled `core`, `docs`, `landing` and `tooling` rows. On #3086, setting the title right after `make pr-open` cancelled run 39021313679 and showed six failing rows. The same title edit is the workaround for `make pr-open` using the branch name as the title (see pr-open-multi-commit-title-20261017).
